mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Latin adjective ending in "-ndus"."
A gerundive is a Latin adjective ending in "-ndus".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mood is used for expressing commands."
The imperative mood is the mood is used for expressing commands.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used mainly for affirmative commands."
The imperative in the Hebrew language is used mainly for affirmative commands.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simple verb stem of the Hebrew language."
Qal is the simple verb stem of the Hebrew language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of the imperfect to complete the consecution of an action."
The consecutive imperfect is the use of the imperfect to complete the consecution of an action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an imperfect which pictures only the beginning of the action."
The simple incipient imperfect is an imperfect which pictures only the beginning of the action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used, it would be followed by the demonstrative and the two would agree with the substantive in gender, number and definiteness."
Note that if the adjective is used, it would be followed by the demonstrative and the two would agree with the substantive in gender, number and definiteness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of verb that is used to form complex tenses."
The participle is a form of verb that is used to form complex tenses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unique preposition of the Hebrew language."
Preposition Nmi is a unique preposition of the Hebrew language.
fib: ______ is the use of the infinitive as a gerund or as a gerundive.
infinitive construct
The infinitive construct is the use of the infinitive as a gerund or as a gerundive.
______ is used to describe reiterated actions, habits, customs or universal truths.
frequentative imperfect
The frequentative imperfect is used to describe reiterated actions, habits, customs or universal truths.
______ is used to express conditional ideas and thus, the imperfect is naturally used.
subjunctive mood
The subjunctive mood is used to express conditional ideas and thus, the imperfect is naturally used.
______ is an action, which though has occurred repeatedly, has no reference to habit, custom or progress.
simple frequentative
The simple frequentative is an action, which though has occurred repeatedly, has no reference to habit, custom or progress.
______ is used to denote a simple action that is completed in relation to another action.
perfect of relation
The perfect of relation is used to denote a simple action that is completed in relation to another action.
______ is used to join two words together whether nouns or verbs.
waw conjunctive
The waw conjunctive is used to join two words together whether nouns or verbs.
______ can be defined as the use of the verbal noun to express the bare idea of the verbal action.
infinitive absolute
The infinitive absolute can be defined as the use of the verbal noun to express the bare idea of the verbal action.
______ is the use of the imperfect in which the author views the action as being either in the process of being repeated or of progressing in the frequent actions.
progressive frequentative
The progressive frequentative is the use of the imperfect in which the author views the action as being either in the process of being repeated or of progressing in the frequent actions.
